title: Shared Northstar design system as the visual source of truth

title: Repo health-check command (bin/verify)
as_a: staff member running a local-only keel instance
i_want: one command that verifies my repo copy is sane
so_that: I can trust my instance without asking the operator
ac: bin/verify checks: stories.json parses as array, IDs unique, decisions.md headings match D-nn format, adapters match regeneration, overview.html newer than newest file under data/ or laws/
Each check prints one line prefixed PASS / WARN / FAIL
Exit code 0 when no FAIL, exit code 1 when any FAIL occurs
Stale-adapters detection works by regenerating adapter content in memory and diffing against files on disk
dod: Stdlib Python only, no pip installs
Documented in METHOD.md section 4 toolchain line
Committed via accept flow with evidence list

title: Seed stack law (laws/stack.md)
as_a: agent compiling a run pack or operator trusting constraints
i_want: keel toolchain constraints held as a versioned law file
so_that: packs bind execution to real stack rules instead of an empty laws dir
ac: laws/stack.md exists with three sections: Toolchain, Artifacts, Runtime
Toolchain section states stdlib-Python-only for bin/, no pip installs, no build step
Artifacts section states markdown/JSON files in git, no external database
Runtime section names git as the only runtime dependency
bin/pack output for any story lists law/stack.md under its Laws heading
dod: Committed via accept flow with evidence list

title: Clean project skeleton (bin/init)
as_a: staff member starting a real client project with keel
i_want: a command that turns a fresh keel clone into a clean project workspace with a code home
so_that: I start from a blank contract sheet instead of inheriting the method repo history, and project code has a defined place
ac: bin/init resets data/stories.json to an empty array and decisions.md to header plus format note only
FAILURES.md and AMENDMENTS.md keep their rules text but start with empty ledgers
archive/ contents are removed keeping directory structure, overview.html is deleted
src/.gitkeep is created as the home for project code
bin/, METHOD.md, laws/, adapters/, skills/, README.md, PLAN.md stay byte-identical
STATE.md is regenerated for a new project: phase P0 project start, resume cue about capturing first intent via story-workshop, last verified never
second run without --force exits non-zero with a message naming the --force flag
dod: Stdlib Python only, wired into bin/keel dispatcher plus bin/init wrapper
Documented in METHOD.md section 4 toolchain line
Accepted via accept flow with evidence list

title: Overview v2 — human review ergonomics
as_a: operator reviewing delivered work and deciding acceptance
i_want: the overview page to carry everything an acceptance decision needs onto one screen
so_that: human review is faster than opening files, and human+machine delivery is truly optimized
ac: Story details render AC and DoD items as interactive checkboxes so a reviewer can tick progress while reading; checkbox state is session-local and never persisted
Stories in review status appear in the Needs-you section with a relative link to their newest evidence bundle and its first three lines quoted inline
Backlog stories display a gate chip computed at render time showing PASS or the number of open issues, using the same checks as bin/gate
Stories with archived packs or evidence bundles under archive/ show clickable relative links to those artifact paths
The page keeps its existing section set - header, Needs-you, Progress, In-flight, All stories, Recent decisions, Resume cue - and adds no new top-level sections
The page stays one self-contained HTML file with zero JavaScript and opens from file://
dod: Gate logic is reused from the bin/gate implementation rather than duplicated
bin/render runs clean on this repo and bin/verify stays green afterwards
Accepted via accept flow with evidence list
